name: Drift & Quality Watch
tagline: Quality trends exist; automated drift watch does not yet.
summary: Nine-dimension quality scoring, benchmark comparison, and agent quality profiling are implemented today. A production drift-watch surface is still missing, so this SKU is not sellable yet.
description: The repository already contains a self-improving quality engine with nine scoring dimensions, feedback-source weighting, benchmark comparison, and agent quality profiles. It does not currently contain a production `drift_detection` module for vector baselines, behavior anomaly detection, or automated degradation alerting. OBS-03 therefore documents the intended package, but it remains a not-yet-sellable SKU until the drift-watch half exists in production code.
buyer: A team with agents in production that wants ongoing quality visibility and, eventually, production drift alerts before silent degradation reaches customers.

features.name: Nine-dimension quality scoring
features.detail: Accuracy, Completeness, Relevance, Timeliness, Clarity, Actionability, Innovation, Depth, and Credibility are already modeled in code.

features.name: Feedback-source weighting
features.detail: Client, peer, expert, automated, and outcome feedback sources are separately tracked and scored.

features.name: Benchmark comparison
features.detail: Quality benchmarks compare deliverables against thresholds and segment expectations.

features.name: Agent quality profiles
features.detail: Per-agent strengths, weaknesses, trajectories, and consistency metrics are recorded.

features.name: Drift-watch blocker
features.detail: Vector baselines, behavior anomaly watches, and degradation alerts still need a production implementation.

source_components.maps_to: src/sincor2/quality_scoring_engine.py — current quality scoring, benchmarking, and profile engine. No production drift_detection module is present yet.

readiness.blocker: No production drift_detection implementation exists for vector baselines, behavior anomaly detection, or degradation alerts.
readiness.next_action: Ship a real drift-watch module and alert path, then re-open OBS-03 for quoting.
